terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms govern your use of BuyCarMap. By accessing or using the service, you agree to them. Please read them carefully.

sections.heading: About the service
sections.body: BuyCarMap aggregates second-hand car listings published on third-party platforms such as Wallapop, coches.net and Milanuncios, and shows them together on an interactive map. We are a search and comparison tool: we do not sell vehicles, hold listings, or take part in any transaction between buyers and sellers.

sections.heading: Your account
sections.body: You may browse without an account. If you create one, you are responsible for keeping your credentials secure and for all activity under your account. Provide accurate information and notify us of any unauthorized use.

sections.heading: Acceptable use
sections.body: Use BuyCarMap only for lawful, personal, non-commercial purposes. Do not attempt to scrape, overload, reverse-engineer, or disrupt the service, and do not use it to infringe the rights of others.

sections.heading: Third-party listings
sections.body: Listing details — price, mileage, photos, availability and seller information — originate from the source platforms and are shown as provided. We do not verify them and cannot guarantee their accuracy, completeness, or that a vehicle is still available. Always confirm details directly with the seller before acting.

sections.heading: No warranty
sections.body: The service is provided “as is” and “as available”, without warranties of any kind. We do not guarantee that BuyCarMap will be uninterrupted, error-free, or that results will meet your requirements.

sections.heading: Limitation of liability
sections.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, BuyCarMap is not liable for any loss arising from your use of the service or from any transaction with a seller found through it, including the purchase of a vehicle.

sections.heading: Changes to these terms
sections.body: We may update these terms as the service evolves. Material changes will be reflected by the “last updated” date above, and continued use of BuyCarMap means you accept the revised terms.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: Questions about these terms? Reach us at hello@buycarmap.com.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what data BuyCarMap collects, why, and what you can do about it. We aim to collect as little as possible.

sections.heading: Information we collect
sections.body: If you create an account, we store your email address, an optional display name, and a securely hashed password — never the password itself. If you sign in with Google, we store the identifier of that account, the sign-in tokens it issues and the address of your profile picture. If you turn on two-factor authentication, we store its secret in encrypted form. We also store the listings you save as favourites, the alerts you create with their search criteria (including any location you chose or, if the search started from “Your location”, your approximate location), your language so emails reach you in it, and, for each signed-in session, the IP address and browser it came from, so you can see and end your sessions from your account page. We do not keep a history of your searches. To protect the service from abuse, we process your IP address and, when you sign in or ask for a password reset, your email address.

sections.heading: How we use your data
sections.body: We use your data to provide the service: to authenticate you, keep you signed in, keep your favourites and alerts, send you account and alert emails, protect the service from abuse, and improve how BuyCarMap works. We do not sell your personal data.

sections.heading: Location
sections.body: To centre the map on you, we may ask your browser for your location. It is used to centre the map and to search near you, so our server sends its coordinates to Wallapop with your search. It is never stored on our servers unless you save it as part of an alert. You can decline, and we fall back to the centre of Spain.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: We use only the cookies the app needs to work: one that keeps you signed in; while you sign in, a short-lived one for the two-factor step (10 minutes) or for signing in with Google (5 minutes); and two that remember your language and your time zone for one year. We do not use advertising or analytics cookies.

sections.heading: Third-party services
sections.body: We rely on these external providers, and each receives only what it needs: Neon (database hosting) stores everything we keep; Vercel (hosting) receives every request, including your IP address; Resend (email delivery) receives your email address and the content of the emails we send you; Google (sign-in) receives your sign-in request, only if you choose to sign in with Google; Have I Been Pwned (leaked-password check) receives the first five characters of a one-way hash of a new password, never the password itself; Upstash (abuse protection) receives your IP address and a one-way hash of your email address, kept for at most one hour; Sentry (error reports) receives technical details of errors, without cookies, your IP address or your account details; OpenStreetMap / Nominatim (place search) receives the place you type, straight from your browser; OpenFreeMap (map tiles) receives tile requests straight from your browser, which show the area you are viewing; Wallapop (listings) receives your search filters and the coordinates of the search: the location you chose, your browser's position, or the centre of Spain; coches.net and Milanuncios (listings) receive your search filters. Our server sends the requests to Wallapop, coches.net and Milanuncios, so they see its address, not yours. Their handling of any data is governed by their own privacy policies.

sections.heading: Data retention
sections.body: We keep your account data, favourites and alerts for as long as your account is active. A favourite or alert you remove is erased 30 days later. When you delete your account, its data is removed at once, except the search criteria of an alert that another user's alert also uses: those are kept, no longer linked to you, until no alert uses them. Unconfirmed sign-ups, password-reset and confirmation links, and abuse-protection records are deleted after they expire.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You can request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data at any time. Depending on where you live, you may have additional rights under laws such as the GDPR.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: For any privacy question or request, contact us at privacy@buycarmap.com.
